title.en: Unit 1 Notes — Introduction to Water Supply Engineering
title.gu: યુનિટ 1 Notes — Water Supply Engineering નો પરિચય

body.en:
Water supply engineering plans, collects, treats, stores and distributes adequate safe water reliably and economically. It protects health by reducing exposure to pathogens and harmful chemicals and supports domestic use, institutions, commerce, industry and fire protection.

Typical system components:

  1. Protected source and intake or well.
  2. Raw-water conveyance and pumping where required.
  3. Treatment chosen for the actual source-water quality.
  4. Clear-water storage and distribution network.
  5. Quality monitoring, metering, operation and maintenance.

Safe at the treatment outlet is not enough: contamination may enter through leaks, backflow, unclean storage or intermittent low pressure.
body.gu:
Water supply engineering પૂરતું safe water વિશ્વસનીય અને આર્થિક રીતે આપવા planning, collection, treatment, storage અને distribution કરે છે. તે pathogens તથા હાનિકારક chemicals ના સંપર્કમાં ઘટાડો કરીને આરોગ્યનું રક્ષણ કરે છે અને domestic use, institutions, commerce, industry તથા fire protection ને ટેકો આપે છે.

સામાન્ય system components:

  1. Protected source અને intake અથવા well.
  2. જરૂર મુજબ raw-water conveyance અને pumping.
  3. Actual source-water quality મુજબ પસંદ કરેલું treatment.
  4. Clear-water storage અને distribution network.
  5. Quality monitoring, metering, operation અને maintenance.

માત્ર treatment outlet પર safe હોવું પૂરતું નથી: leaks, backflow, અસ્વચ્છ storage અથવા intermittent low pressure થી contamination પ્રવેશી શકે છે.

body.en:
Sources and characteristics:

  • Surface water: rivers, lakes and reservoirs are often available in large quantity but can vary seasonally in turbidity, microorganisms and pollution.
  • Groundwater: springs, dug wells and borewells are naturally filtered to some extent but may contain dissolved salts, hardness, fluoride, iron or other contaminants; it is not automatically safe.
  • Rainwater: harvested from roofs or catchments for storage or recharge; yield is seasonal and depends on rainfall, catchment, losses and storage hygiene.
  • Sea or brackish water: potentially usable with desalination, appropriate pretreatment and management of concentrated reject.
body.gu:
Sources અને characteristics:

  • Surface water: rivers, lakes અને reservoirs માં મોટા પ્રમાણમાં પાણી મળી શકે, પરંતુ turbidity, microorganisms અને pollution ઋતુ પ્રમાણે બદલાય છે.
  • Groundwater: springs, dug wells અને borewells નું પાણી કુદરતી રીતે થોડું filtered હોય છે, છતાં તેમાં dissolved salts, hardness, fluoride, iron અથવા અન્ય contaminants હોઈ શકે; તે આપોઆપ safe નથી.
  • Rainwater: roofs અથવા catchments પરથી storage અથવા recharge માટે એકત્ર થાય છે; yield ઋતુ, rainfall, catchment, losses અને storage hygiene પર આધારિત છે.
  • Sea અથવા brackish water: desalination, યોગ્ય pretreatment અને concentrated reject management સાથે ઉપયોગી બની શકે છે.

body.en:
Assessment points:

  • Health: microbiological and chemical quality must comply with applicable drinking-water standards, not merely look clear.
  • Acceptability: objectionable colour, taste, odour and turbidity can make water unpleasant, although pleasant appearance does not prove safety.
  • Reliability: source yield should meet demand in dry seasons and drought as well as normal years.
  • Suitability for use: domestic, industrial and construction uses have different quality requirements.

Test representative samples and use a risk-based water safety plan. Refer to the current applicable IS 10500 and local authority requirements; identify the need for treatment and protection.
body.gu:
Assessment ના મુદ્દા:

  • Health: માત્ર પાણી સ્વચ્છ દેખાવું પૂરતું નથી; microbiological અને chemical quality લાગુ drinking-water standards સંતોષે.
  • Acceptability: અપ્રિય colour, taste, odour અને turbidity થી પાણી અસ્વીકાર્ય બને, જોકે સારો દેખાવ safety નો પુરાવો નથી.
  • Reliability: સામાન્ય વર્ષ સાથે dry season અને drought માં પણ source yield માંગ પૂરી કરે.
  • Suitability for use: domestic, industrial અને construction uses માટે quality requirements અલગ હોય છે.

Representative samples તપાસો અને risk-based water safety plan વાપરો. વર્તમાન લાગુ IS 10500 અને local authority requirements જુઓ; જરૂરી treatment અને protection નક્કી કરો.

h.en: 1.4 Selection and protection of a source

body.en:
Selection procedure:

  1. Estimate current and future demand, peak flow and design period.
  2. Assess dependable yield, seasonal variation, drought and competing withdrawals.
  3. Examine quality over time, pollution risks, flood and climate exposure, and required treatment.
  4. Compare distance, elevation, energy, land, permissions, construction and life-cycle costs.
  5. Protect the catchment or wellhead and arrange sampling, backup supply and monitoring.

A cheap nearby source may be unsuitable if it is contaminated or unreliable. Never choose solely by a single test or peak-season yield.
body.gu:
પસંદગીની પ્રક્રિયા:

  1. વર્તમાન અને ભવિષ્યની demand, peak flow અને design period નો અંદાજ લો.
  2. Dependable yield, seasonal variation, drought અને અન્ય withdrawals તપાસો.
  3. સમય પ્રમાણે quality, pollution risks, flood અને climate exposure તથા જરૂરી treatment તપાસો.
  4. Distance, elevation, energy, land, permissions, construction અને life-cycle costs સરખાવો.
  5. Catchment અથવા wellhead નું રક્ષણ કરી sampling, backup supply અને monitoring ગોઠવો.

પાસેનો સસ્તો source contaminated અથવા અવિશ્વસનીય હોય તો યોગ્ય ન પણ હોય. ફક્ત એક test અથવા peak-season yield પરથી પસંદગી ન કરો.

title.en: Numerical 1.1 — Compare source yield with demand
title.gu: Numerical 1.1 — Source yield અને demand સરખામણી

body.en:
Given: A town needs 2.4 million litres per day. A source reliably yields 30 L/s in the dry season. Compare the quantities, ignoring losses.

Step 1. Convert the source yield to litres per day.

Yield = 30 × 86400Yield = 2,592,000 L/dayYield = 2.592 MLD

Step 2. Compare with the stated demand.

Surplus = 2.592 − 2.400Surplus = 0.192 MLD

Final answer:

The yield exceeds the stated demand by 0.192 MLD before losses; quality, future growth and permits still require checking.
body.gu:
આપેલ છે: Town ની demand 2.4 million litres per day છે. Dry season માં source ની dependable yield 30 L/s છે. Losses અવગણી quantities સરખાવો.

Step 1. Source yield ને litres per day માં ફેરવો.

Yield = 30 × 86400Yield = 2,592,000 L/dayYield = 2.592 MLD

Step 2. આપેલ demand સાથે સરખાવો.

Surplus = 2.592 − 2.400Surplus = 0.192 MLD

અંતિમ જવાબ:

Losses પહેલાં yield આપેલ demand કરતાં 0.192 MLD વધુ છે; quality, future growth અને permits હજુ તપાસવાં જરૂરી છે.
